name: protein kinase cAMP-activated catalytic subunit alpha

function.text: PRKACA encodes cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit alpha. Annotated molecular activities include cAMP-dependent protein kinase activity and histone H1-4S35 kinase activity. It participates in cAMP/PKA signal transduction and bone resorption.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cardioacrofacial dysplasia 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Fibrolamellar carcinoma; Extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
